subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The driver told her not to worry.”?
options: He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop.
A man at the bus stop said, "Point it into the wind first."
After that day, Ray always thanked the driver when getting off the bus.
Three days later, Anna saw a little girl wearing a red scarf at the bus stop.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The driver told her not to worry. He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A man at the bus stop said, 'Point it into the wind first.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「After that day, Ray always thanked the driver when getting off the bus.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Three days later, Anna saw a little girl wearing a red scarf at the bus stop.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The driver told her not to worry. He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop.」，答案為「He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「He called the bus office and helped her get off at a safe stop.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
